name: process_coins
purpose: Decode two packed four-channel coin-counter samples, apply the configured multiplier/bonus, and update per-player coin totals and pending credits
arguments: previous packed 2-bit counter sample; current packed 2-bit counter sample
exceptional_convention: normal two-slot stack ABI; only each slot's low byte is consumed

name: get_coin_multiplier
purpose: Validate the complementary coin-configuration bytes and derive the current coin multiplier
return: D0.l = multiplier 1-4, or 0 for free play/invalid high setting

name: calc_health_per_coin
purpose: Fold pending credit units into one player's bounded coin accumulator and convert it to health units
return: D0.l = 12 * accumulated coin units / multiplier, or 24 in free play
exceptional_convention: normal stack ABI; mutates the selected pending and accumulated coin bytes

name: check_and_deduct_coin
purpose: Check whether one player has at least twelve health units of credit and deduct one multiplier group
return: D0.l = 1 on success/free play, 0 when insufficient

name: check_and_deduct_credits
purpose: Check a player's pending-plus-accumulated credit units and consume the requested amount
arguments: required credit units long; player index long
return: D0.l = 1 on success/free play, 0 when insufficient
exceptional_convention: normal stack ABI; consumes pending units before accumulated units

name: read_eeprom_setting
purpose: Read one difficulty-row histogram byte when that row is available
arguments: difficulty threshold/row long; bin index long
return: D0.l = byte value, -1 when bin index exceeds 19, or -2 when current difficulty is not above the requested row

name: read_game_config
purpose: Decode one packed game-configuration item through the descriptor table
return: D0.l = decoded value; index 13 returns the signed game difficulty byte; indexes above 13 return -1

name: read_high_score_entry
purpose: Expand one five-byte EEPROM high-score record into the shared score/ASCII work buffer
return: D0.l = pointer to seven-byte expanded entry, or 0 when rank exceeds 9
exceptional_convention: normal stack ABI; character class is expected to be 0-3 and is not bounds-checked

name: write_high_score_entry
purpose: Encode and insert one expanded score/initials record into a class table and queue affected EEPROM regions
arguments: character class word; rank word; expanded-entry pointer
return: D0.l = 0 success, -1 when rank exceeds 9, or -2 when score exceeds 24 bits
exceptional_convention: normal stack ABI; character class is expected to be 0-3 and is not bounds-checked

name: update_active_player_time_stats
purpose: Accumulate elapsed VBLANKs for active players, periodically fold hours into configuration counters, and update the active mask
return: D0.l = pointer to the first per-player elapsed-VBLANK counter at 0x904F50
exceptional_convention: normal stack ABI; queues EEPROM regions when hour counters change

name: write_eeprom_setting
purpose: Apply the public setting-write policy and delegate packed configuration storage
return: D0.l = -1 for index above 13; otherwise the delegated writer's observable result
exceptional_convention: normal stack ABI; indexes below 11 are forcibly written as zero

name: write_game_config
purpose: Pack one configuration value according to the descriptor table and queue affected EEPROM regions
return: D0.l = -1 for index above 13; a changed ordinary value returns queued region 0 or 1; unchanged-value paths leave an incidental work value
exceptional_convention: normal stack ABI; index 13 clears difficulty rows and queues their regions

name: rank_high_score
purpose: Compare a 24-bit score against one class's ten EEPROM records
return: D0.l = rank 0-9, 10 when score does not rank, or -1 when score exceeds 24 bits
exceptional_convention: normal stack ABI; character class is expected to be 0-3 and is not bounds-checked

name: activate_player_time_tracking
purpose: Add one player to the active-time mask and immediately account elapsed VBLANKs
return: D0.l = pointer to the first per-player elapsed-VBLANK counter at 0x904F50
exceptional_convention: normal stack ABI; tail result is propagated from 0x3BE8

name: record_player_session_histogram
purpose: Remove a player from active-time tracking, normalize the elapsed session by coin count/difficulty, and increment the corresponding EEPROM histogram bin
arguments: player index word in a long slot; coin-count/divisor word in a long slot
exceptional_convention: normal two-slot stack ABI; divisor is capped at 128 and is expected nonzero
